body.name: Reduced common-history sensitivity polytope
body.construction: \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)=\{x\in\mathbb R_+^{|\mathcal S|}:\sum_sx_s=1;\ \sum_s\widetilde g_{tav}(s)x_s=b_{tav}\text{ for every }(t,a,v)\in\mathcal T\times\mathcal A\times\mathcal V;\ \sum_s\mathbf 1\{h_t^0=v\}x_s=q_{tv}\text{ for every }(t,v)\in\mathcal T\times\mathcal V_0;\ x_s=0\text{ if }h^0\neq h^1;\ \sum_{s,v}\omega_v\{r_{10v}(s)-r^{[0]}_{20v}(s)\}x_s=0;\ \sum_s\mathbf 1\{h_1^0=u,r_{1au}=0\}\mathbf 1\{r^{[u]}_{2av}\neq r^{[0]}_{2av}\}x_s\leq\delta\sum_s\mathbf 1\{h_1^0=u,r_{1au}=0\}x_s\text{ for every }(a,u,v)\in\mathcal A\times\mathcal V\times\mathcal V\}\).
